UnitStatement: The pandid-valve-tile brief schema describes TASK dispatch by DRAWING_EXTRACT for one P&ID tile.
A pandid-valve-tile brief requires TaskSkill to be pandid-valve-tile.
A pandid-valve-tile brief must set AllowedWriteTargets exactly to RuntimeOverrides.OUTPUT_PATH.
RuntimeOverrides.SOURCE_PDF_NAME must provide the source PDF basename.
RuntimeOverrides.PAGE_NUM must be a positive integer.
RuntimeOverrides.TILE_ID must follow the page_NNNN_rRRcCC format.
RuntimeOverrides.TILE_IMAGE_PATH must reference an existing tile PNG.
RuntimeOverrides.OUTPUT_PATH must be the target .md path.
RuntimeOverrides.MODE must be either basic or detailed.
RuntimeOverrides.TILE_GEOMETRY must provide geometry metadata from tile_manifest.json.
RuntimeOverrides.ALLOW_REFERENCE_SHEETS, when true, prevents self-skipping of reference sheets.
RuntimeOverrides.SCOPE_FILE records optional operator-selected page scope provenance.
RuntimeOverrides.BASIC_REFERENCE_RUN records optional detailed-mode provenance.
RuntimeOverrides.BASIC_COUNTS_CSV records optional detailed-mode provenance for the basic counts CSV.
Custom instructions should use the whole tile image for context.
Rows are emitted only for valve symbols whose visual center is inside the solid emit-zone border.
Valve candidates visible outside the emit zone belong only in notes.
The 5x5 grid overlay is used for approx_location_in_emit_box.
Pixel coordinates must not be emitted.
issue_flags is a list, and an empty list is serialized as [].
Unknown or unreadable classification fields are TBD.
A legend, reference, or symbol-sheet tile returns NO_FINDINGS_REFERENCE unless ALLOW_REFERENCE_SHEETS is true.
Minimum QA checks require TILE_IMAGE_PATH to exist.
Minimum QA checks require OUTPUT_PATH to have a .md extension and an existing parent directory.
Minimum QA checks require MODE to be basic or detailed.
Minimum QA checks require TILE_GEOMETRY to include body, read, and emit boxes.
Minimum QA checks require exactly one output file to be written.
Minimum QA checks require frontmatter to match runtime parameters.
Minimum QA checks require finding_count to equal the emitted row count.
Minimum QA checks require approx_location_in_emit_box to be one of A1 through E5.
Minimum QA checks require issue_flags to serialize as [] or [FLAG_A, FLAG_B].
Minimum QA checks require basic mode not to emit detailed columns.
Minimum QA checks require detailed mode to include valve_size_text, valve_type_code, valve_type_name, and actuation.
Reference, legend, symbol, and abbreviation pages return NO_FINDINGS_REFERENCE with finding_count 0 unless ALLOW_REFERENCE_SHEETS is true.
Invalid runtime inputs produce FAILED_INPUTS.
Unreadable tile content produces FAILED.
No valve candidates in the emit zone produces NO_FINDINGS.
Unknown issue flags are warnings for deterministic validators, not page-worker failures.
The pandid-valve-tile skill is an obsolete legacy per-tile P&ID valve candidate extraction skill retained for historical readability.
New DRAWING_EXTRACT P_AND_ID valve_count_basic and valve_count_detailed runs do not dispatch pandid-valve-tile.
New P&ID valve runs must dispatch pandid-valve-symbol-instance instead of pandid-valve-tile.
Legacy pandid-valve-tile rows must not be auto-migrated into symbol_instance_v1.
pandid-valve-tile extracts valve candidate rows from one P&ID tile image.
A pandid-valve-tile tile contains a larger read zone and a smaller emit zone drawn by deterministic preprocessing.
pandid-valve-tile may use the read zone for context but emits only valve symbols whose visual center lies inside the emit zone.
pandid-valve-tile supports basic and detailed modes.
basic mode emits count-oriented candidate rows with coarse valve category, visible tag, location bucket, and issue flags.
detailed mode emits basic columns plus valve size, valve type, and actuation where visible.
The suitable shell for pandid-valve-tile is TASK in generic shell mode spawned by DRAWING_EXTRACT.
TILE_GEOMETRY must include tile_grid, body_exclusions, read_box_px, emit_box_px, overlap_px, and mini_grid.
ALLOW_REFERENCE_SHEETS defaults to false.
BASIC_REFERENCE_RUN provides provenance for the basic run used for reconciliation.
BASIC_COUNTS_CSV provides provenance for the basic counts CSV used for reconciliation.
pandid-valve-tile invokes no deterministic tools inside the skill.
Tile preparation, validation, assembly, aggregation, duplicate flagging, and reconciliation belong to orchestrator-invoked deterministic tools.
The pandid-valve-tile method begins by validating runtime inputs.
The pandid-valve-tile method reads TILE_IMAGE_PATH.
A legend, symbols, abbreviation, or reference sheet emits NO_FINDINGS_REFERENCE with reason legend_or_reference_sheet unless ALLOW_REFERENCE_SHEETS is true.
The method inspects the read zone for context.
The method emits only valve candidates whose visual center is inside the outlined emit zone.
The method uses the 5x5 overlay to assign approx_location_in_emit_box values A1 through E5.
In detailed mode, size, type, and actuation fields are filled only when visible; otherwise they are TBD.
The pandid-valve-tile method writes exactly one markdown stub at OUTPUT_PATH.
valve_category controlled values are manual_block, manual_throttle, check, control, esd_block, relief, and unknown.
tag_basis controlled values are visible_near_symbol, inferred_from_designation, and TBD.
The initial issue_flags vocabulary contains BOUNDARY_REVIEW, LOW_LEGIBILITY, AMBIGUOUS_SYMBOL, CLASSIFICATION_UNCERTAIN, SIZE_NOT_LEGIBLE, and LINE_NUMBER_NOT_LEGIBLE.
Unknown future issue flags may be emitted, but validators record warnings.
Every pandid-valve-tile output stub begins with YAML frontmatter matching the runtime geometry.
Basic output body columns are valve_index, valve_category, valve_tag, tag_basis, approx_location_in_emit_box, issue_flags, and notes.
Detailed output adds valve_size_text, valve_type_code, valve_type_name, and actuation columns.
issue_flags is serialized as [FLAG_A, FLAG_B], and an empty value is serialized as [].
SUCCESS means one or more candidates were emitted.
NO_FINDINGS means no valve candidates were found in the emit zone.
NO_FINDINGS_REFERENCE means a reference or legend page was detected and not overridden.
FAILED means the tile could not be interpreted.
FAILED_INPUTS means required runtime inputs were missing or invalid.
One pandid-valve-tile invocation handles one tile.
The emit-zone rule is mandatory.
Visible candidates outside the emit zone are not emitted as rows.
Pixel coordinates are not requested or used by pandid-valve-tile.
approx_location_in_emit_box must be one of A1 through E5.
Tags are extracted when visible but are never required.
Unknown values are TBD.
pandid-valve-tile writes only OUTPUT_PATH.
QA expects frontmatter geometry to match the run.
QA expects finding_count to equal the number of emitted body rows.
NO_FINDINGS and NO_FINDINGS_REFERENCE outputs have finding_count 0.
Basic mode must not emit detailed columns.
Detailed mode must include detailed columns.
Every emitted candidate must have non-empty valve_index, valve_category, approx_location_in_emit_box, and issue_flags.
pandid-valve-tile is reasoning-first; deterministic tile preparation happens before dispatch.
pandid-valve-tile reads one prepared tile image and writes one stub.
pandid-valve-tile has no TASK-enforced deterministic tools.
pandid-valve-tile has no operationally invoked deterministic tools.
pandid-valve-tile uses visual reasoning over the tile image to identify valve candidates.
pandid-valve-tile uses reasoning to respect the emit-zone contract and classify candidate fields by active mode.
pandid-valve-tile disallows shell commands.
pandid-valve-tile disallows web access.
pandid-valve-tile disallows deterministic OCR invocation.
pandid-valve-tile disallows reading images outside the declared tile input.
pandid-valve-tile disallows writing outside OUTPUT_PATH.
pandid-valve-tile disallows sub-agent fanout.
The tool policy write boundary is exactly RuntimeOverrides.OUTPUT_PATH.
